inspection_items: Check the enclosure, chassis, and external surfaces for visible cracks, dents, corrosion, or deformation.
Check power cables, data cables, ports, connectors, switches, and controls for visible damage.
Check screens, displays, lenses, indicators, and other visible output surfaces for damage.
Check cooling fans, vents, filters, and openings for obstruction or obvious damage.
Check for loose components, exposed wiring, damaged power connections, overheating signs, or other visible hazards.
Check the instrument body, frame, base, enclosure, mounting points, and external surfaces for visible cracks, dents, corrosion, or deformation.
Check power cables, probes, sensors, hoses, connectors, terminals, switches, and controls for visible damage or disconnection.
Check displays, screens, lenses, mirrors, optical components, measurement scales, and other visible measurement surfaces for damage.
Check knobs, buttons, stages, moving parts, handles, rails, guards, fixtures, and adjustment mechanisms for visible damage, misalignment, or loose components.
Check for exposed wiring, fluid leakage, damaged insulation, missing safety guards, loose parts, overheating signs, or other visible safety hazards.
